So when I was little, I used to camp monthly, but when I got a little older I was diagnosed with sleep apnea. I got a cpap and after years of use I have become tethered to it. Trying to sleep without it feels worse to me than not sleeping at all.

Does anyone else here deal with this? How do you cope?

I looked into cpap batteries, but insurance doesnt cover that stuff and they start and hundreds of dollars for a basic one.

It would seem you have two options. Either save the money for the batteries, or reserve a car camping site with electric hookup. The latter won't feel as much like camping if you're used to backpacking, though.

I figured it was a shot in the dark. My girlfriends family have a camper in a campground with electricity. But between it being in a camper and there being 200 other campers all packed together I'm hard pressed to call it "camping" at all, other than there's no toilet and its in the woods

Look around for larger and more isolated parks. In Southern Ontario, we can go to hydro sites that are jam packed full of people and their huge trailers. That's where we pull out the patio lanterns. :) But if we go just a bit north, the sites get larger, the people fewer, and our little pop up doesn't get pinned in between two gigantic house trailers. We've even stayed in parks on a serviced site where there were only two other campers in the campground. Going offseason and weekdays helps that too. If you can, find a park that allows you ample hiking or canoeing opportunities along with less crowded sites at night. If you can be out all day at some serious hiking, then just head back to the site at night, maybe you will feel more like being backwoods?

Font Tweaking:

  1. Go to the TERA\Client\S1Game\Localization\USA folder.

  2. Rename the GFxUI into something else (Back it up :sick:)

  3. Go up one folder and enter the INT folder.

  4. Copy both files from there and paste them into the USA folder.

  5. Rename the GFxUI.int into GFxUI.usa

Caution: By doing this you will not be able to see letters like ä ü ö â anymore

Change FOV:

Navigate to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\TERA\Client\S1Game\Config (or where ever you installed the game)

Open up the file "S1Input.ini" Underneath the line "bEnableMouseSmoothing=true add the line below. Make sure it's on its own line.

Bindings=(Name="end",Command="fov 90")
Bindings=(Name="home",Command="fov 70")

(You can set those values to whatever you want to btw)

Make sure there is no ; at the start of the line like there are with the lines under it.

Save the file, and after that you should right click on the S1Input.ini go to properties and check the box read-only and hit ok.

When you're in game, pressing "end" will change the fov to your desired value.

Pressing "home" will change the fov back to default.

Both of these tweaks work in the steam version of Tera as well. There are other various improvements to the game client, but these are the best QOL improvements IMO.
